summary: Tutor Contribution Blog + backend refactor. BACKEND: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_babybabel_blog.py 15/15 PASS (public list/detail w/ 4 editorial posts, tag filter, pending/rejected hidden from anon/others -> 404, author/admin can view, tutor-only create (parent 403, anon 401), 3 images -> 422, foreign/external image paths -> 422, cover defaults to first image, PATCH author-only, rejected->pending on edit w/ notes cleared, published can't be edited/deleted by author (400), admin publish/reject/unpublish + 403 for non-admin, status filters, notifications 'Your article is live!' / 'Article needs revisions' delivered, admin delete published). W-9 regression after refactor: session7 + session8_fernet all pass (24 + 11 after rate-limit restart). FRONTEND (375x667): signed-out /blog list (4 cards, tag chips, Guides filter -> 1), detail hero+body; tutor sofia drawer shows drawer-blog-compose + drawer-blog-me, blog CTA visible, compose with title/topic/summary/body, file-chooser multi-select uploads 2 photos, add button hides at 2/2, remove + re-add works, submit -> /blog/me 'In review'; admin panel Pending/Published/Rejected filters, expand, reject w/o note blocked by toast, reject w/ note -> moves to Rejected; tutor /blog/me shows 'Needs revisions' + quoted feedback + Revise -> compose shows Admin feedback, prefilled title + 2 photos, 'Resubmit for review' -> In review; admin Publish -> appears signed-out on /blog and detail shows hero + extra photo. compose-gate shown signed-out and for parent; parent drawer hides compose. Issues are minor UX (see below).

minor.issue: cover_image_url is accepted as any arbitrary string (external URL) and is NOT validated against the author's uploads, bypassing the image_urls ownership check (tutor can set a hotlinked/tracking cover). Should be forced to image_urls[0] or validated with _clean_images.
Empty reviewer_notes accepted server-side (only UI enforces 'note required').

No status check (works on pending/rejected posts too) and no notification to author. Also unpublished post keeps reviewer_notes 'Temporarily unpublished for review.' which AdminBlogPanel pre-fills into notes and then re-sends as reviewer_notes on Publish.
limit not clamped (to_list(limit) with user value); unlike /api/posts which clamps 1..100.
Publishing an editorial post pushes a notification to non-existent user id 'babybabel-editorial' (orphan notification doc).

ui_bugs.issue: Gate renders before auth hydrates (useAuth().loading ignored). Hard-loading /blog/compose as a signed-in parent shows 'Sign in' button for ~1-3s (tapping it goes to /login which bounces to '/'); signed-in tutor deep-link briefly flashes the gate. Should show a spinner while loading. Gate subtitle also says 'Sign in with a tutor account' to already-signed-in parents.

After submit/resubmit, router.replace('/blog/me') when compose was pushed from /blog/me leaves TWO /blog/me screens in the stack (verified: 2 elements for my-post-status-{id}, stale one shows 'Needs revisions'). Back arrow returns to the stale list. Use router.back()/dismissTo when coming from /blog/me.
Parent sees '+' (my-posts-new) header button on /blog/me even though only tutors can write.

issues: Editorial posts show '0 photos' and no image when expanded although they have a cover_image_url (panel only renders image_urls).
Compose topic chips (Guides, Activities, Culture, Tips, Tutor spotlight) differ from editorial tags (Trends, Mission) - inconsistent taxonomy.
Header title 'Blog' on list vs 'Journal' on detail.

action_items: compose.tsx: respect useAuth().loading - render ActivityIndicator until auth hydrated before deciding on compose-gate; tweak gate copy for signed-in parents
compose.tsx: after submit navigate back (router.back() or dismissTo('/blog/me')) instead of replace to avoid duplicate /blog/me in stack
blog.py: validate/force cover_image_url to image_urls[0] (or run through _clean_images) in create & patch
blog.py: require non-empty reviewer_notes on reject; restrict unpublish to published posts and notify author; clamp admin list limit
AdminBlogPanel: don't pre-fill 'Temporarily unpublished' note; show cover_image_url when image_urls empty
me.tsx: hide '+' header button for non-tutors
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still 1776 lines (>700) even after moving blog/W-9 out; further split recommended (auth, bookings, uploads, admin).

routes/*.py use `from server import db, ...` with include_router at bottom of server.py - works because uvicorn imports module 'server', but it's a circular import; moving shared deps (db, auth deps, push_notification) to a core module would be safer.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) found in package.json.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass; minor auth-hydration gate flash + nav stack issue)

seed_data_creation: Test posts created via API/UI prefixed TEST_ and deleted afterwards. Uploaded small test images for sofia/marie remain in db.uploads. Editorial post 'raising-bilingual' was unpublished/republished once during probing (status published, published_at preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run blog suite with `-n 0` (pytest.ini adds xdist). Login rate limiter triggers 429 after ~8 logins/IP - restart backend between suites. Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Web photo picker opens a file chooser with multiple=true; use page.expect_file_chooser.
rca_of_issue: Gate flash: compose.tsx checks `user?.role !== 'tutor'` on first render while AuthProvider.loading is still true (token read from storage async), so user is null and gate shows 'Sign in'.
